about.title: About
about.label: Get to know me
about.description:
Hi, I'm Gaurav Mishra, a full stack developer based in New Delhi, India, currently in my final year of Computer Science Engineering.

I build and ship end-to-end applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript on the frontend and Spring Boot, Node.js, and PostgreSQL on the backend. I've worked with LLM APIs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to integrate AI features, containerised services with Docker, and secured apps with JWT authentication.

Currently a Data & AI Intern at the Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India. I'm actively looking for SDE internships and full-time roles in India or remote — let's build something great together.

items.title: Flapboard â€” AI-Powered Adaptive Typing Platform
items.description: Flapboard is an AI-powered adaptive typing platform that tracks real-time WPM and accuracy, provides a performance dashboard, and generates targeted drills from past weaknesses. Built a Spring Boot REST API with JWT authentication and PostgreSQL for user accounts, typing sessions, and progress history; containerized the backend with Docker. Developed a typing test with real-time WPM and accuracy tracking, a performance dashboard, and an adaptive module that generates targeted drills from past weaknesses. Integrated a live LLM API that structures performance metrics into personalized coaching, keeping calculations in deterministic code and using the LLM only for explanations.

items.title: Golf Cart â€” Full-Stack Fundraising Platform
items.description: Golf Cart is a role-based full-stack fundraising platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL (Neon), Prisma, Razorpay, and Zod. Implemented organization registration with document upload and an admin verification workflow, plus campaign management and donation tracking. Designed a relational schema (Profile, Organization, Campaign, Donation, Payment) in Prisma/PostgreSQL; integrated Razorpay for donation payments with transaction tracking. Added AI-assisted campaign writing and search with Zod-validated structured outputs grounded in database records.

items.title: HireTrack â€” Recruitment Management Platform (ATS)
items.description: HireTrack is an Applicant Tracking System built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Neon), Auth.js, bcrypt, and shadcn/ui. Built credentials-based authentication with bcrypt password hashing and protected dashboard routes, with recruiter-scoped job creation and listing. Designed a relational schema (User, Job, Candidate, Application) with a unique candidateâ€“job constraint to prevent duplicate applications, and per-application hiring stages (Applied â†’ Screening â†’ Interview â†’ Offer â†’ Hired/Rejected).
